growth_signal.value: This round adds to an earlier J-KISS raise, bringing cumulative funding to about $2.1M, with new backers including Coral Capital, FFG, Animoca Brands and HashPort joining.

raised.value: About ¥324M ($2.1M) cumulative, via J-KISS convertible notes

entry.idea: People and businesses that earn and spend in Japanese yen but borrow in US-dollar stablecoins end up exposed to two currencies moving at once, so DeltaForesight is building a lending system that lets them borrow a yen-tracking crypto stablecoin instead.
entry.lesson: When your customers already use a global product that creates a currency mismatch for them, build the local-currency version of it instead.
entry.name: DeltaForesight

growth.basis: substitute: repeat funding round with new backers (Coral Capital, FFG, Animoca Brands, HashPort)
growth.reason: The protocol is still under development with no mainnet or users yet, so the only real signal is that several serious investors backed a second funding round.

market.reason: A yen-pegged stablecoin serves crypto users and businesses tied to one country's currency, which is a real niche rather than a mass-market product yet.

tech.reason: Overcollateralized crypto lending with automatic liquidation is a well-known DeFi design, similar to existing protocols, so a strong team could copy it within a year or two.

sources.title: 「JPYdf」DeFi開発のDeltaForesight、Coral Capitalリードで3.24億円調達
DeltaForesight | A new force for society.

entry.twist: Its protocol, JPYdf, is backed only by crypto collateral locked in a smart contract, which is automatically sold off if its value drops too low, so no bank or company holds the money behind it.
entry.who_pays: Crypto holders and businesses who want yen-priced loans would eventually pay fees or interest to borrow JPYdf, once the protocol's mainnet is live.
entry.why_now: Japan is opening up clearer rules for crypto assets and stablecoins just as more businesses there start borrowing in digital assets, leaving room for a yen-focused option instead of only dollar ones.
